title: Monsoon Roadtrip Itinerary
description: A slow travel plan for a rainy weekend escape.
body:
We mapped a small monsoon route that included roadside chai, old bookstores, and the best views after a storm.

Day 1

Arrive mid-morning and take the coastal road toward the hills.

Day 2

Explore the local market, find a quiet cafe, and read while the rain patters outside.
